title: Refresh every count-dependent closeout surface after ledger growth
failure_signature: The terminal-correction current suite found a stale effective-negative total and stale final Method Flow method count after two new methods were appended.
candidate_workaround: Rebuild evidence registers first, rebuild closeout and final Method Flow mirrors second, verify the new totals directly, and only then rerun the unchanged current tests.
recurrence_guard: Any retained-negative or Method Flow append invalidates every generated count mirror until the evidence and closeout builders refresh them together.
rollback: Retain the two-test failure, award no current-suite credit, and modify no frozen proposal or executed outcome.
scope_boundary: This is bounded same-owner artifact-generation evidence only; it is not independent reproduction or broader scientific, authority, security, accessibility, identity, production, or Stage 20 evidence.
